about_the_game:
A POINT AND CLICK MYSTERY SPANNING 100 YEARS

Northern Patagonia, 1880. A man called Salvador Ocampo disembarks on Mapuche territory with a group of settlers. Twenty years later he will disappear without a trace.

Buenos Aires, 1977. The arrival of a mysterious letter puts into question everything that Lucía thought she knew about herself and her family.

And in between, almost a century of lies, betrayal and death. A curse, they say. But people say so many things.

FIND OUT THE TRUTH ABOUT YOUR ANCESTORS

A hunter, obsessed with ensnaring the ultimate prey. A mother, consumed by guilt. An archaeologist, blinded by ambition. A poet, driven to the depths of madness and despair. And so many others.

As Lucía, you'll dive into a trove of documents, letters, cassette tapes, films and diaries, reliving the last moments of each family member and piecing together the fate that befell them.

But as your investigation progresses, one question starts taking shape: are you doomed to suffer the same end as them?

KEY FEATURES

  • Point and click interface.

  • Deduction mechanics: gather clues and place them on your board to reconstruct the Ocampo family tree.

  • A story inspired by family sagas such as 100 Years of Solitude or Chronicle of the Murdered House.

  • Breathtaking pixel art in glorious 320x180 resolution, and punctilious animations that make every scene feel alive.

  • An immersive soundtrack that moves seamlessly between Argentinian folk music, dark ambient, and classical piano.

  • Blood, death, cruelty. Caveat emptor.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains references to adult topics such as suicide, murder, violence, trauma or cannibalism.

These topics, however, are for the most part not depicted directly and are only referenced as having happened in the past, or they form the context for certain scenes that are set in the aftermath of such events.

short_description: The bloody roots of the Ocampo family tree run deep and dark in this mystery point-and-click adventure. Investigate the last moments of your ancestors and put together the pieces of the family's macabre fate to find out who you really are.
